configurePresets.name: msys2-clang
configurePresets.displayName: MSYS2 UCRT64 Clang (matches llvm-config for cvm-translate)
configurePresets.description: Use the msys2 ucrt64 clang/clang++ so the C/C++ compiler and the LLVM dev libraries that cvm-translate links against come from the SAME distribution. Mixing scoop's mingw-mstorsjo-llvm (libc++, no llvm-config) with msys2's LLVM headers breaks libc++'s #include_next chain (cwctype/cwchar/... errors). See docs/BUILDING.md.
